dimension_literal_resolution.method: linear scan info_type/info varlen (113 rows), read id.bin at matching row
linear scan kind_type/kind varlen (7 rows), read id.bin
linear scan link_type/link varlen (18 rows), collect matching ids into std::vector<int32_t>

join_order.strategy: scan country_code varlen (234997 rows), set bit in std::vector<uint8_t> us_company[max_company_id+1]
join_order.notes: About 1/3 of companies are US. Bitset enables O(1) lookup during mc probe.
For each lt_id in set, iterate aux CSR rowids[off[lt_id]..off[lt_id+1]).

join_order.strategy: title__id__pos[t1_id] -> t1_row; title__id__pos[t2_id] -> t2_row; skip if either == -1

join_order.probe: movie_info_idx via primary CSR on movie_id=t1_id, then test info_type_id==rating_info_type_id
join_order.notes: Need at least one mi_idx1 row; if multiple, we read info to compute MIN.

join_order.probe: movie_info_idx via primary CSR on movie_id=t2_id, test info_type_id==rating AND info < '3.0' (lexicographic varlen compare)
join_order.notes: info column is varlen text; compare as string_view < '3.0'.

join_order.probe: movie_companies via primary CSR on movie_id=t1_id, test us_company[company_id]==1
join_order.notes: Need at least one mc1 row matching; read company_name.name for MIN(cn1.name).

join_order.probe: movie_companies via primary CSR on movie_id=t2_id (no country filter)
join_order.notes: Read company_name.name for MIN(cn2.name) via company_name__id__pos.

parallelism.partitioning: Collect ml rowids from aux CSR for all lt_ids into a single std::vector<int32_t> (size ~5000), partition equally across 12 threads
parallelism.reduction: Each thread keeps thread-local 6 MIN strings; final reduction merges lexicographic min
parallelism.notes: Driver fan-out is small (~5K rows); could be single-threaded too, but parallel scan amortizes random I/O on primary CSR probes.

indexes.purpose: range scan mi_idx rows for given movie
range scan mc rows for given movie
map company_id to company_name row for MIN(name) projection

early_exit: NOT SAFE - must scan all surviving combinations to compute true MIN
